visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera slowly pans across a bright, high-end closet display. A white tweed cardigan with a prominent Chanel brooch and a multi-strand pearl necklace hangs in the center. To the left, a white quilted Chanel bag and a coral-colored one are displayed on a door panel. The background features a framed fashion illustration of a woman. (2) The scene cuts to a white rectangular plate containing four diverse desserts: a flan tart with a flaky crust, a sponge cake slice layered with strawberries and mango, a dark chocolate lava-style cake topped with a strawberry, and a green grape tart. Behind the plate, two green glass bottles of Perrier mineral water are placed on a light-colored table. (3) A right hand with neutral-toned manicured nails enters the frame, holding a silver spoon and taking a delicate bite of the fruit-layered sponge cake. (4) The camera focuses closely on a fluffy, textured white tweed handbag with a gold-tone Chanel logo and chain strap. The hand gently adjusts the bag to showcase its soft, fuzzy material against a backdrop of a luxury boutique interior with wooden shelves and other accessories.
